summary: Wombat now organizes local history, usage, project diagnosis and cleanup around five task-oriented commands. One Skill selects the evidence needed for the task and helps verify authorized improvements.
highlights: Use history, usage, check, clean and system as the five CLI entries. Search or resume conversations, read selected dates and turns, and query familiar periods such as week. Commands provide focused text and JSON help; detailed generated methods are available through system api and system call.

Run wombat check for a read-only project diagnosis covering checks, AI configuration, recent work and cleanup candidates. Each section retains its own completeness or error state. Review consequential findings and confirm selected changes before applying them; diagnosis does not automatically edit the project.

Use one Skill with five task references for history and usage, diagnosis, AI environment review, cleanup, and execution with verification. Suggestions identify the affected owner, the smallest useful change and the original case to repeat. No project initialization is required.

Find conversation records from event evidence even when metering is absent. Read history in bounded pages and selected turns while keeping usage accounting independent and preserving unknown, zero, partial and unpriced results.

CI builds now run independent checks in parallel, reuse verified native artifacts, use pinned prebuilt audit tools and cache dependencies. Documentation-only PRs skip the heavy matrix while still resolving the CI result; main pushes retain full five-platform verification.
knownLimitations: The CLI surface has changed without compatibility aliases. Update the runtime and Codex plugin together. Replace old top-level api and call commands with system api and system call; use command --help --json for the current interface.

Codex is the production history source. Unsupported mappings, missing records and changed evidence remain explicit limitations. Current configuration and absent usage cannot prove historical loading or justify removal.

Project diagnosis combines independently observed sections; it is not an atomic snapshot of every project component. Partial or unavailable sections do not establish a complete review or a verified repair.

Supported Codex artifact cleanup currently targets macOS layouts and permanently removes only authorized selected candidates. General project cleanup uses authorized project or native tools. No general undo or automatic cleanup history is provided.

CLI queries run locally without model calls or conversation uploads. Selected Skill evidence enters the current Codex conversation and consumes Tokens. Large evidence queries may require narrower dates or turns; no hard request-latency or memory limit is promised.
